core: Core*=S; T_acc=F(S,C,L); phenomenon=Delta T_acc; consequence=Delta Reach -> Delta Trajectory; I is mechanism, not primitive.
hypothesis: The derived accessible-transformation structure R adds reproducible out-of-sample predictive utility beyond a conventional snapshot representation B that excludes relational transformation structure.
null: R adds no incremental predictive utility beyond B.
algorithm: HistGradientBoostingClassifier, identical fixed hyperparameters in both arms
statistical_test: paired Monte-Carlo sign-flip permutation test on per-test-episode log-loss differences, 200000 flips, fixed seed 13579
decision_rule: Primary support requires Delta>=0.04 and paired permutation p<0.05. Strong support additionally requires TGCV improvement over count-only and permuted-R controls and same-direction replication with RandomForest.
representation_scope: B includes component count, three resource values, and objective identity; B deliberately excludes relational edge structure. R is derived from accessible transformations at the frozen snapshot.
critical_coherence_correction: Since R is deterministic from S, the earlier conditional statement P(Y|S,B,R)!=P(Y|S,B) would be tautologically unavailable when S is fully observed. The valid empirical claim is representation-level incremental utility P(Y|B,R)!=P(Y|B).
no_retrofit: No Core, MVE, R definition, outcome, delta, dataset, or model-selection rule may be altered after test-set sealing.
